author: ViTaLDRuG
text:
I will be starting my own journal here. I will be trading my demo
account first. I have lost a lot in that account. So my first goal is it
 get its balance to where it was when I opened that account. I will be
posting all trades ( sweet ones and bitter ones). I will clearly explain
 how I looked into the past, then the approach and the reaction on which
 I entered the trade.

Feedback is more than welcome.

I will start with the post which I missed by one or two pips.

Past

It was a clear S/R flip zone in USDCHF M30. I was waiting till it was
broken up. So I can enter when it again reached the broken S/R flip zone
 for a long.

Approach

I really don't know what the approach here is. It slowly came to the
broken zone. If anyone can comment on what the approach is, I really
appreciate it.

Reaction

I was waiting for a Quasimodo to be formed. It formed. But I missed the
last low swing my one pip or two. But I think that missed QM can be
considered a FTR in M30 and I can re-enter for a long. Lets see.

You must look for LQ and CP....LQ - always show us intention of
